items.title: Retail Landlords Are Nearly Full, and $120,000 Across These 3 REITs Pays $4,997 a Year
items.summary: Mall, grocery-anchored, and open-air landlords are packing in tenants at levels not seen in years, and each of these three REITs just raised its payout. One simple number tells you whether the checks will keep coming.
